carmen: Heads-up — scheduling rolling maintenance for the "orion" rack cohort in us-west1 on Sat 2025-11-08 04:00 UTC. Work: NIC microcode + small kernel micro-patch + net powercap tweak. Plan: cordon -> drain -> soft reboot -> apply fw -> health checks -> uncordon. Expect ~8-12% GPU capacity dip regionally; each cohort ~25-35m.

leo: Which racks and any dedicated pools that need manual routing?

carmen: 4 racks (orion-01..orion-04). Mix of hosted + two small dedicated pools (ded-orion-a/b). We'll pin those to us-west2 standby during their windows. Router will rebalance hosted traffic to us-west2/us-east1 automatically.

zara: KV/prefix cache plan? pre-seed?

carmen: Pre-seed top-25 prefixes 20m before cohort start. Canary on orion-01 at ~10% nodes first, run perf-probe: `bench/infer --model rdl-3b --qps 0.5 --seq 512 --duration 15m` and observe p50/p95/p99. Success = p99 < baseline + 30ms and token throughput within 12%.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2025-11-08 04:00 UTC — orion nic+kernel maintenance

leo: Fallback if KV warmup fails or we see p99 spikes?

carmen: Fallbacks:
- abort the cohort and rollback NIC fw on that rack
- fail-open routing to standby pools (us-west2 / us-east1)
- enable aggressive prefix-only routing for affinity=true tenants
- if sustained >15m, spin up prebaked warm spares in us-west2 (up to 20%) and notify finance

zara: Can we get a quick cost cap for spill/warm spares so finance can pre-authorize?

carmen: Ballpark: cross-region token egress ~130k tokens/hr -> ~$35/hr. Warm spares worst-case ~$160/hr. Requesting $220/hr cap to be safe. I'll attach per-cohort breakdown after canary.

finance-bot: Noted. Tag @finance at 50% of cap.

leo: Support blurb for CS?

carmen: Paste for CS: "Planned maintenance Sat 2025-11-08 04:00 UTC in us-west1 (orion racks). You may see short latency increases (up to ~60ms) or brief error spikes for <30m per cohort. Dedicated tenants routed to standby pools; if sustained >15m degradation, escalate to eng-infra oncall and attach request id + sample traces."

oncall: I'll be on rotation that window, watching canary metrics. If p99 > baseline + 60ms abort and roll back.

carmen: final check: any objections to the time window? will post incident page and reminders (1h, 30m, 10m). CC: @oncall @platform-ops.

leo: none from me. :thumbsup:

zara: good to go. please stream canary graphs here during the run.

carmen: Incident page created: https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-2025-888 (private). I'll post canary metrics live and open a postmortem if anything deviates.
